thread:
Jordan (AE): FYI Zenith Labs wants to convert POC -> PO. Procurement sent a PO from Czech holding but legal says MSA must be signed by UK trading entity. They also sent a security questionnaire and redlined pricing: a 3-month POC discounted flat fee and a price floor for inference tokens after term. Need legal + finops + security on POA, invoicing entity, SLA credits cap, and whether we can accept the pricing carveout.

Lisa (Legal): paste the redline pricing + any contract language they attached? also who is the procurement contact? if signer differs from billed entity we need a POA and confirmation of intercompany payment flow.

Jordan (AE): procurement contact=procurement@zenithlabs.eu. Redline snippets below.

```
Pricing Addendum: "Provider agrees to a POC fee of EUR 25,000 (covers up to 50M tokens) for first 3 months. Post-POC, Provider agrees to a price floor of EUR 0.0003 per token for 12 months. Failure to meet performance SLAs entitles Customer to withhold up to 20% of monthly fees."

SLA excerpt: "Provider guarantees 99.9% availability. Credits calculated at 5% of monthly fees per 0.1% below threshold, uncapped."
```

Priya (Security): a few items: (1) monthly SOC snapshot demand is heavy — we provide SOC2 reports and can provide a scoped attestation via SOW, not a monthly custom snapshot for Hosted. (2) HSM attestation only for Dedicated/Private. (3) questionnaire — send the filled security questionnaire; some answers will require product-ops input.

Omar (FinOps): on pricing: the flat POC fee is fine to accept as a promo but price floor = sticky commitment; need revenue approval and ARR modeling. Also intercompany billing: if Czech holding issues PO but UK entity signs, we need a billing annex mapping payer and payer address; VAT implications depend on invoiced entity. Holding CO VAT? need VAT reg num.

Lisa (Legal): countersuggests: (a) remove "withhold up to 20%" and replace with capped service credits schedule; (b) change uncapped SLA credits to a capped remediation (e.g., max 50% monthly fees); (c) convert monthly SOC snapshot to "SOC2 report plus commercially reasonable attestations; additional audit/attestation to be provided under SOW and may incur fees"; (d) list acceptable POA: notarized POA, eIDAS advanced certificate, or corporate board resolution + ID.

Jordan (AE): I'll ask Zenith procurement for the POA scan, VAT number, and confirm who will pay invoices. I'll also ask if they're willing to accept SOW for attestation and a price ladder instead of fixed floor.

esig-bot: Envelope created (env_zen_0x7) for Order Form + Addendum  awaiting signatures.

Omar (FinOps): if they accept our cap and SOW route, finance can accept the POC flat fee promo and model the post-POC tiered pricing. If they insist on the floor, we need rev ops + sales leadership sign-off.

Priya (Security): once they confirm Dedicated/Private or request attestation, I'll open a product-ops ticket to scope timeline (likely 30-60 days) and any SOW fees.

Lisa (Legal): I'll prepare a redline that replaces payment-withhold with capped credits, adds the POA annex and the SOW path for attestation, and includes VAT/invoicing language. Jordan  target signature date?

Jordan (AE): aiming EOW. pinging procurement off-thread for POA + VAT reg + payer confirmation. Will upload their completed security questionnaire when it comes in. :thumbsup:
